covered_report_window: Monday, October 5, 2026 after the current U.S. market close through Tuesday, October 6, 2026 before the next U.S. market open. No qualified Monday after-close reporters were confirmed; APOG, RPM, and LW are confirmed Tuesday before the open.
market_context_summary: U.S. equities were firm near record levels, while the 10-year Treasury yield was around 5.3%. September ISM Services remained expansionary at 54.9 but price pressures intensified; Friday's 29,000-job payroll gain kept the Fed path uncertain. High rates and sticky input costs are relevant to construction, coatings, and restaurant-demand-sensitive reporters.

ranked_companies.timing: Tuesday, October 6, 2026 before market open; call at 10:00 a.m. ET
